display_long_description:
Join our Discord community for playtests, events, and updates: [https://discord.gg/mechup]

**COLLECT & BUILD YOUR MECH**

Collect mech parts and create a unique mech of your own. Mix and match different components, customize your weapons, and upgrade your mech to take on greater challenges.
[media]

**PILOT YOUR MECH**

Step into the cockpit and experience what it feels like to control a giant mech in VR. Move, grab, and fight using your own hands as you become a true mech pilot.
[media]

**FUSE WITH FRIENDS**

Team up with another player and fuse your mechs into one massive fusion mech. Work together, coordinate your movements, and unleash the power of two pilots controlling one powerful mech.
[media]

**BATTLE GIANT ENEMIES**

Equip powerful weapons and take on massive bosses in action-packed VR combat. Defeat enemies, collect mech parts and upgrade materials, and grow stronger with every battle.
[media]

**EXPLORE THE WORLD**

Explore a sci-fi world filled with secrets, resources, enemies, and powerful bosses. Team up with friends, discover new areas, and uncover the mysteries of the planet.
[media]
